## Control library

64 controls, version 1.0.0, served at `/framework/controls` (CAP-003) with one page per control (CAP-004). Framework mappings are indicative.

| Pillar | Name | Controls | Critical | High | Medium | Low |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AO | Accountability & Operating Model | 12 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 0 |
| EI | Enterprise AI Inventory | 12 | 4 | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| GL | Governance & Lifecycle Control | 12 | 2 | 8 | 2 | 0 |
| IS | Integrity, Safety & Security | 16 | 7 | 8 | 1 | 0 |
| SE | Stewardship, Evidence & Assurance | 12 | 1 | 6 | 5 | 0 |

|---|---|
| VERITRAIL method | AI inventory, Control, Governance Baseline, Maturity level, Pillar, Prohibited-review, Release gate, Risk tier, TILLER |

| Runtime guardrails and AI security | Adversarial testing, AI agent, Default-deny, Human approval, Human oversight, Jailbreak, Kill switch, Policy-as-code, Prompt injection, Redaction, Rollout mode, Tool manifest |
| Regulation and standards | AI management system, Conformity assessment, Deployer, EU AI Act, General-purpose AI model, High-risk AI system, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF |
